get-started.title: Create your account or sign in
get-started.summary: Join as someone looking for care or as a caregiver, in a few short steps.

steps.1: On the first screen tap [[ui:welcome.getStarted]], then [[ui:start.needCare]] or [[ui:start.caregiver]]. If you already have an account, tap the sign-in button instead.
steps.2: Choose how you will sign in: [[ui:signup.whatsapp]] (no password to remember) or [[ui:signup.email]].
steps.3: With WhatsApp, enter your number and tap [[ui:signup.sendCode]]. Type the code you receive on WhatsApp and tap [[ui:signup.verify]].
steps.4: Fill in the short form about you (and the care you need), read and accept the agreement, then tap [[ui:signup.submit]].
steps.5: Rather not fill in a form? Tap [[ui:signup.callOffice.title]] to call our office, and we will register you on the phone.

tips.1: Next time, sign in the same way you chose here. With WhatsApp, a new code is sent each time.
tips.2: You can change the app's language at any time from the first screen or from [[ui:nav.myAccount]].

find-caregiver.title: Find a caregiver
find-caregiver.summary: Search for caregivers near you, look at their profiles and ask to be put in touch.

steps.1: Tap [[ui:nav.find]]. Use [[ui:searchMode.normal]] to choose from lists, or [[ui:searchMode.ai]] to describe what you need in your own words.
steps.2: Choose the [[ui:normalSearch.careType]], the [[ui:normalSearch.district]] and the [[ui:normalSearch.city]], then tap [[ui:normalSearch.submit]].
steps.3: Tap a caregiver to see their profile: experience, skills, languages, ratings and when they can work. [[ui:results.verified]] means our team has checked their identity and documents.
steps.4: Tap [[ui:care.contactCta]] to ask our team to put you in touch. We call you both and arrange the care.
steps.5: Tap [[ui:care.save]] to keep a caregiver on your list for later.

tips.1: For your safety, caregivers' names and numbers are shared by our team on the phone, not in the app.
tips.2: No one suitable? Tap [[ui:care.findForMe.cta]] and our team will look for you.

ask-for-care.title: Ask us to find care
ask-for-care.summary: Send a request and follow it while our team arranges a caregiver.

steps.1: Tap [[ui:account.requests.newRequest]] (or [[ui:care.contactCta]] on a caregiver's profile). Choose the type of care, where it is needed and when it should start, and send it.
steps.2: Open [[ui:account.requests.title]] from [[ui:nav.myAccount]] to see each request and what our team is doing about it. You also get a message whenever it moves on.
steps.3: If you have a question, tap [[ui:talk.title]]. Someone from our team will contact you.
steps.4: If you no longer need the care, tap [[ui:account.requests.cancel]] on the request.

tips.1: Our team calls you and the caregiver before anything is booked. Nothing is charged until care is arranged with you.
tips.2: Once a caregiver is agreed, the booking appears under [[ui:account.nav.bookings]].

follow-visits.title: Follow your visits
follow-visits.summary: See when your caregiver is coming, follow them on the way, and confirm they have arrived.

steps.1: Tap [[ui:account.nav.bookings]]. Each booking shows its upcoming [[ui:account.bookings.shifts]], who is coming, and when they arrived and left.
steps.2: Before a visit, the [[ui:checkIn.client.title]] appears. When the caregiver arrives, tell them this code: they enter it in their phone to show they are with you.
steps.3: When the caregiver taps [[ui:onMyWay.start]], you see them on a map and about how many minutes away they are.
steps.4: If another caregiver covers a shift, it says so next to that shift.
steps.5: If something is not right with a visit, tap [[ui:issues.report]] and tell us what happened.

tips.1: Only give the arrival code to the caregiver at your door - never on the phone.
tips.2: To see how far away the caregiver is, put a pin on the home under [[ui:places.title]] in [[ui:nav.myAccount]].

labels.onTheWay: Your caregiver is on the way

tick-off-care.title: Tick off today's care
tick-off-care.summary: Each day, mark what the caregiver did from the care plan, so the office knows the care was given.

steps.1: On [[ui:account.nav.bookings]], find [[ui:carePlan.todayTitle]]. It lists the activities on the care plan for today. [[ui:carePlan.important]] ones matter most, like medicines.
steps.2: Tap [[ui:carePlan.done]] for each one the caregiver did.
steps.3: Tap [[ui:carePlan.notDone]] if something was not done, and say what happened. The office sees it.
steps.4: Use [[ui:carePlan.previousDay]] to go back to yesterday until midnight.

tips.1: Anything you leave unmarked at midnight counts as done.
tips.2: Turn on [[ui:carePlan.reminders]] if you would like a reminder in the evening.

rate-caregiver.title: Rate your caregiver
rate-caregiver.summary: After care, give stars and say what went well. It helps other families and the caregiver.

steps.1: On [[ui:account.nav.bookings]], tap [[ui:reviews.rateNow]] or [[ui:reviews.rateCaregiver]] next to the caregiver.
steps.2: Choose from one to five stars, and tap the badges that fit.
steps.3: If you like, write a review for other families. Our team checks it before it appears on the profile. You can also leave a note that only our office sees. Then tap [[ui:reviews.form.submit]].
steps.4: You can change your rating with [[ui:reviews.edit]] until the date shown.

tips.1: Stars and badges count straight away. The written words appear once our team has approved them.
tips.2: If a caregiver covered only some shifts, you can rate them separately.

labels.writeReview: A few words for other families

pay-invoice.title: See and pay invoices
pay-invoice.summary: Open your invoices, pay online, and keep a copy.

steps.1: Open [[ui:invoices.title]] from [[ui:nav.myAccount]]. Each invoice shows the total, what is left to pay and the due date. [[ui:invoices.overdue]] ones are past their date.
steps.2: Open an invoice and tap [[ui:invoices.pay.button]] to pay by card or mobile wallet through PayHere.
steps.3: Come back to the app when the payment is finished. The invoice shows it as paid.
steps.4: Tap [[ui:invoices.pdf.download]] to keep or share a copy.

tips.1: If an invoice is not paid by its date, visits may pause until it is. Paying restarts them.
tips.2: Paid by bank transfer or cash instead? Our team records it, and the invoice updates.

caregiver-documents.title: Get verified: your documents
caregiver-documents.summary: Upload your ID and certificates so our team can verify you and offer you work.

steps.1: Open [[ui:portal.documents.title]] from [[ui:nav.home]] or [[ui:nav.myAccount]]. [[ui:portal.documents.needed]] shows which documents are still missing.
steps.3: Tap [[ui:portal.documents.takePhoto]] to photograph it, or [[ui:portal.documents.choosePhoto]] for one you already have. Make sure every word is easy to read.
steps.4: Add the expiry date if it has one, then tap [[ui:portal.documents.upload]].
steps.5: Check [[ui:portal.profile.title]] too: your personal details, qualifications and experience help families choose you.

tips.1: If a document is not accepted, the app says so. Upload a clearer or corrected copy.
tips.2: We remind you before a document runs out, so you can upload the new one in time.

job-offers.title: Answer job offers
job-offers.summary: When a family needs someone like you, our team sends you an offer. Accept it or say no.

steps.1: When an offer arrives you get a message. Open [[ui:portal.offers.title]]: each offer shows the area, the start, the kind of care and what you are paid.
steps.2: Tap [[ui:portal.offers.accept]] if you can take it. Our team then confirms the booking with the family.
steps.3: Tap [[ui:portal.offers.decline]] if you can't, and choose why. The offer goes to someone else.
steps.4: Answer before the time shown - after that the offer may go to another caregiver.

tips.1: You get the family's name and address once the booking is confirmed.
tips.2: A cover offer is for one shift only: [[ui:portal.offers.cover.accept]] adds it to your shifts.

work-a-shift.title: Work a shift
work-a-shift.summary: Go to the visit, check in with the arrival code, follow the care plan, and check out.

steps.1: On the day, open [[ui:portal.nav.shifts]]. When you leave, tap [[ui:onMyWay.start]] so the family can see you are coming. It stops when you check in.
steps.2: At the door, ask the family for their arrival code. Type it in [[ui:checkIn.caregiver.codeLabel]] and tap [[ui:checkIn.caregiver.checkIn]].
steps.3: Tap [[ui:carePlan.showPlan]] to see what to do on this shift. [[ui:carePlan.important]] tasks, like medicines, must not be missed.
steps.5: If you can't come, tap [[ui:portal.shifts.cantMake.button]] as early as you can, so the office can send someone else.
steps.6: If something went wrong on a shift, tap [[ui:issues.reportShort]] and tell our team.

tips.1: While you are checked in, the app checks your location now and then. Only the office sees it, and it stops when you check out.
tips.2: Too many wrong codes lock the check-in. Then phone the office and they will check you in.
tips.3: If a shift says [[ui:portal.shifts.paused]], do not go.

set-rates.title: Set your rates
set-rates.summary: Choose what you charge for each kind of care, within the range the office allows.

steps.1: Open [[ui:portal.rates.title]] from [[ui:nav.myAccount]]. For each kind of care, enter [[ui:portal.rates.rate]] within the range shown.
steps.2: Under each rate you see what families will see, with the office's fee included.

tips.1: For other kinds of care, the office agrees the rate with you for each job.

caregiver-payments.title: See your payments
caregiver-payments.summary: Follow what you are paid for the shifts you worked.

steps.1: Tap [[ui:portal.nav.payments]]. Each statement shows what it is for and the amount. Approved means the payment will be sent soon.
steps.2: Once paid, it shows the date and the transfer reference, so you can find it in your bank account.
steps.3: Your ratings from families are under [[ui:reviews.caregiver.title]] in [[ui:nav.myAccount]].

tips.1: Payments appear here once our team has approved them.
tips.2: If an amount looks wrong, tap [[ui:talk.title]] and tell us which shift.

talk-to-person.title: Talk to a person
talk-to-person.summary: Whatever you need, someone from our team will contact you.

steps.2: If it is about a request, a booking or a shift, choose it under [[ui:talk.about]].
steps.3: Choose [[ui:talk.contact]]: a call, WhatsApp or email.
steps.4: Tap [[ui:talk.send]]. Our team contacts you soon.

tips.1: Your earlier messages and our answers are listed under [[ui:talk.mine]].

account-settings.title: Look after your account
account-settings.summary: Set where care happens, how we contact you, your language, and how you sign in.

steps.1: Open [[ui:nav.myAccount]]. Under [[ui:places.title]], put a pin on the home where care happens, so caregivers find it and you see when they are close.
steps.2: Under [[ui:commsPrefs.title]], choose how we contact you and when.
steps.3: Change the app's [[ui:common.language]] at any time.
steps.4: Tap [[ui:nav.signOut]] to sign out on this phone.
steps.5: To close your account, tap [[ui:deleteAccount.title]]. It is closed at once and your personal details are erased 14 days later. Changed your mind? Contact our team within those 14 days.

tips.1: You can also unlock the app with your fingerprint or face, if your phone supports it.
tips.2: Notices about your requests, visits and invoices are under the bell at the top of each screen.
